_comment: Recipe Framework Survival pack defaults (not Axolot config.json). Edit and reload world for new defaults. Host /gensettings overrides live in world sm.storage.

_help.frameworkOnly: If true, baseline/framework mode: forces cheats=false and setupQuestTab=false (and RFS quest UI off). Does NOT turn off hijack/beacons/area loader — use host /gensettings for those. ALWAYS keeps ModRecipeScan store hooks, RfsQuest API, progression inject, /mods. Alias: set enableDefaultContent=false instead.
_help.setupQuestTab: Pack default for /setup Quest tab (INFO/START/DONE). Ignored when frameworkOnly=true. World /gensettings 'RFS quests content' can also hide this UI without disabling RfsQuest API.
_help.cheats: Pack default for fly/god/unlimited/give/farmers/tshop/mshop/quest commands and /setup cheat buttons. Host /gensettings can override per-world. Forced false when frameworkOnly=true. Keep /setup /gensettings /menu /mods /help.
_help.worldFlags: Live world flags (cheats, hackDevices, areaLoader, hackableRobots, hackUndergroundBots, streamerMode, streamerCooldownSec, streamerAnnounce, streamerChatRelay, rfsQuests) are stored via RfsFeatures in sm.storage key {rfs,features}. Toggle with host /gensettings. hackUndergroundBots default ON (current miner/cable hijack); set OFF to exclude them.
